about.title: About ELM Landscape Management (Econocuts)
text: ELM Landscape Management has been a key partner for many businesses and individuals around Houston, helping to keep our city neat and green.

ELM was founded nearly 40 years ago with the mission of helping to keep Houston beautiful. As we’ve grown, that mission has grown as well and today we support a variety of businesses and individuals around Houston.

Our team is made up of hardworking and dedicated professionals, each of whom is passionate about outdoor spaces. Our owner, Christophe Merriam, started at ELM Landscape Management over 10 years ago, working alongside employees both in the field and in the office.
